title: Heteroskedastic Signals in Budgeted LLM Verification: Structural Heterogeneity Limits Optimization Gains
authors_zh: Jinlong Yang（机构：西北工业大学）
paper_type_zh: 预算化验证与测试时分配分析
best_for_zh: 诊断基于不确定性的验证路由，或设计预算感知测试时计算策略的读者。
one_line: The paper shows that stratifying a limited verification budget by cost can outperform stronger globally shared adaptive policies when uncertainty signals are not comparable across strata.
当不确定性信号在不同成本层中不可比较时，按成本分层分配有限验证预算可优于更强的全局自适应策略。
why: It gives a negative result with a practical remedy: optimizing a stronger global allocator cannot fix feedback signals whose reliability differs systematically by cost regime.
inclusion_reason: It studies how finite test-time verification compute should be allocated and demonstrates that a globally shared uncertainty signal can misallocate that budget when its reliability changes across cost regimes.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Verification can make a language-model system safer or more accurate, but executing tests, invoking tools, or checking long derivations is costly. A fixed verification budget therefore creates a routing problem: the system must decide which candidate outputs deserve expensive feedback. Many existing policies rank all candidates with one uncertainty or confidence score, implicitly treating equal scores as equally useful regardless of task difficulty or verification cost.

This paper asks whether that global comparability assumption is sound. It examines budgeted verification as a controlled test-time setting in which costs, allocation decisions, and discovered errors are observable. The concern is not simply that uncertainty may be weak on average, but that the same score may identify errors well in one cost regime and nearly at random in another; a globally shared policy can then direct scarce verification away from error-dense cases.

验证能够提升语言模型系统的安全性或准确性，但运行测试、调用工具或检查长推导都要付出成本。因此，固定的验证预算会形成一个路由问题：系统必须决定哪些候选输出值得获得昂贵的反馈。许多已有策略用同一个不确定性或置信度分数为所有候选排序，并隐含地认为，无论任务难度或验证成本如何，相同分数都具有同等的决策价值。

本文追问这种全局可比较性假设是否成立。它把预算化验证作为一个受控的测试时场景，其中成本、分配决策和被发现的错误都可以观测。问题不仅是不确定性平均而言可能较弱，更在于同一个分数或许能在某个成本区间有效识别错误，却在另一个区间几乎等同于随机；此时全局共享策略就可能把稀缺的验证资源从错误密集的案例上移开。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central idea is to separate a weak predictor from a structurally mismatched allocation rule. The paper calls the mismatch heteroskedasticity: uncertainty quality changes across observable cost strata. A single global threshold or globally learned score pools these regimes, even when their score-error relationships differ, and can consequently over-audit cheap regions while under-auditing costly regions with many errors.

The proposed diagnostic is intentionally modest. Instead of adding a more sophisticated learner, cost-stratified thresholding partitions inputs into four ex-ante cost strata and maintains a separate running threshold for each one. It keeps the same fixed uncertainty score and receives no extra labels or gradient updates. If this simpler, structurally aligned policy beats a stronger global learner, the result points to signal comparability rather than optimizer power as the relevant bottleneck.

核心思想是把“预测信号本身较弱”与“分配规则在结构上不匹配”区分开来。论文把这种不匹配称为异方差性：不确定性信号的质量会随着可观测的成本层而变化。单一的全局阈值或全局学习到的分数会把这些不同区间混合在一起，即使各区间中分数与错误之间的关系并不相同；结果可能是对廉价区间过度审核，却对包含大量错误的高成本区间审核不足。

作者提出的诊断方案刻意保持简单。成本分层阈值法把输入按事前成本划分为四层，并为每一层维护独立的运行阈值，而不是增加更复杂的学习器。它使用同一个固定不确定性分数，不获得额外标签，也不进行梯度更新。若这个更简单但结构对齐的策略优于更强的全局学习器，便说明真正的瓶颈是信号可比较性，而不是优化器能力。

title: Method
方法
html:
Each candidate is represented by token-level uncertainty proxies and a predicted verification cost. The proxies summarize average negative log probability, the worst token logit margin, and margin dispersion; a policy combines them into a score and verifies a candidate only if that score exceeds a budget-sensitive cost threshold. The actual budget is based on realized output-length-normalized verification cost, while an input-length-normalized estimate is available before the decision. The evaluation reports error hit rate under fixed budget fractions.

The intervention hierarchy compares four policies. Threshold is a static global baseline. MP-Adapt is a globally shared mirror-prox learner that updates a scoring vector and a dual budget multiplier online. MP-Strat gives cost strata separate dual variables and stabilizes decisions with a teacher-student exponential moving average. CST uses no online learning at all, but assigns independent running quantiles within four predicted-cost strata. A local theoretical model further bounds global allocation distortion by the dispersion of stratum-level discriminability.

每个候选输出由词元级不确定性代理和预测验证成本表示。不确定性代理汇总平均负对数概率、最差词元的对数几率间隔以及间隔离散程度；策略把它们组合为分数，只有当分数超过受预算约束的成本阈值时才验证候选。实际预算按输出长度归一化后的真实验证成本计算，而决策前只能得到按输入长度归一化的成本估计。评测在固定预算比例下报告错误命中率。

干预层级比较四种策略。Threshold 是静态的全局基线。MP-Adapt 是全局共享的镜像近端学习器，在线更新评分向量和预算对偶乘子。MP-Strat 让各成本层拥有独立的对偶变量，并以教师—学生指数滑动平均来稳定决策。CST 完全不进行在线学习，却在四个预测成本层内分别维护运行分位数。论文还在局部理论模型中证明，全局分配失真会随各层可判别性离散程度增加而增大。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The experiments use 500 MBPP programming problems with unit-test feedback and 5,000 MATH problems with answer matching. They evaluate Qwen3-8B, LLaMA3-8B, and GPT-4o-mini at 10%, 20%, 30%, and 50% verification budgets over ten seeds. On the heterogeneous MBPP settings, CST consistently improves over the global threshold: at a 20% budget, the reported gains are 5.1 percentage points for Qwen3, 15.1 for LLaMA3, and 6.5 for GPT-4o-mini.

The evidence is deliberately not uniformly positive. On Qwen3-MATH, CST loses to the global threshold at low budgets, including a 7.6-point loss at 20%. This negative control supports the paper's narrower claim: stratification helps only when the chosen partition captures consequential differences in feedback quality. Additional controls find that partial stratification recovers some performance, whereas stronger global adaptation does not reliably outperform the static threshold; an oracle signal reaches near-perfect hit rate, showing that the framework can exploit reliable signals.

实验使用了 500 个带单元测试反馈的 MBPP 编程题，以及 5,000 个以答案匹配验证的 MATH 题目。作者在 10%、20%、30% 和 50% 的验证预算下，对 Qwen3-8B、LLaMA3-8B 和 GPT-4o-mini 进行十个随机种子评测。在异质性较强的 MBPP 场景中，CST 始终优于全局阈值：在 20% 预算下，Qwen3、LLaMA3 和 GPT-4o-mini 的报告增益分别为 5.1、15.1 和 6.5 个百分点。

证据并非刻意追求全面正向。在 Qwen3-MATH 上，CST 在低预算时反而输给全局阈值，其中 20% 预算下低了 7.6 个百分点。这个负向对照支撑了论文更严格的主张：只有当所选分层真正捕捉到反馈质量的重要差异时，分层才有帮助。额外控制实验表明，部分分层能够挽回一部分表现，而更强的全局自适应并不能稳定优于静态阈值；使用真实标签构成的预言机信号则几乎达到完美命中率，说明该框架能够利用可靠信号。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Its main novelty is a failure analysis of test-time allocation rather than another high-capacity allocation algorithm. The paper turns the usually implicit assumption that uncertainty scores are globally comparable into a falsifiable object, then uses a progression from global thresholding to global adaptation, partial stratification, and non-learning stratification to distinguish three explanations: weak signals, optimization instability, and structural heterogeneity.

The cost-stratified threshold is also a useful methodological contribution because it is intentionally weaker than the learned alternatives. Its gains cannot be attributed to extra feedback, a richer model, or more optimization. Together with the theoretical distortion bound, this makes the empirical finding actionable: before investing in a stronger verifier router, practitioners should inspect whether the score has comparable discriminative value in the observable regimes used for budgeting.

其主要新意是对测试时分配失败进行分析，而不是再提出一个容量更高的分配算法。论文把“不确定性分数在全局上可比较”这个通常被默认接受的假设转化为可证伪的对象，并依次使用全局阈值、全局自适应、部分分层和非学习式分层，来区分三种解释：信号弱、优化不稳定以及结构异质性。

成本分层阈值也是一个有用的方法学贡献，因为它有意比学习式替代方案更弱。它的增益不能归因于额外反馈、更丰富的模型或更多优化。结合理论失真界，这使经验结论可以转化为行动建议：在投入资源训练更强的验证路由器之前，实践者应先检查用于预算决策的可观测区间中，分数是否仍具有可比较的判别价值。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The study is a controlled diagnostic, not a universal routing recipe. It uses cost strata defined from a particular proxy, two benchmark families, three models, injected label and proxy noise, and a small set of uncertainty features. Stratification can harm performance when its partition does not align with meaningful heterogeneity, as the Qwen3-MATH results show. The theory is a local upper-bound analysis under explicit distributional assumptions, so it neither proves that CST always wins nor settles how to discover the right strata in open-ended agent workloads.
这项研究是受控诊断，而不是通用的路由配方。它使用由特定代理定义的成本层、两类基准、三种模型、注入的标签和代理噪声，以及少量不确定性特征。当分区没有对齐有意义的异质性时，分层可能损害表现，Qwen3-MATH 的结果正是如此。理论部分是在明确分布假设下给出的局部上界分析，因此既不能证明 CST 总会胜出，也没有解决在开放式智能体工作负载中如何自动发现正确分层的问题。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This paper is useful when a system has a fixed budget for unit tests, tool calls, formal checks, expensive judges, or multiple verification samples. It suggests adding a diagnostic dashboard before changing the optimizer: report error rate, score-error correlation, audit coverage, and cost by observable stratum. If the relationships differ sharply, a group-conditional policy or calibrated local threshold may be a cheaper and more reliable intervention than retraining a global allocator.
当系统对单元测试、工具调用、形式化检查、昂贵评审器或多次验证采样设有固定预算时，这篇论文很有参考价值。它建议在更换优化器之前先增加诊断面板：按可观测分层报告错误率、分数—错误相关性、审核覆盖率和成本。如果这些关系差异显著，采用群组条件策略或经校准的局部阈值，可能比重新训练全局分配器更便宜且更可靠。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper as a caution about what an uncertainty score means after it is placed inside a budgeted decision loop. The strongest practical lesson is the negative-control result: cost-based stratification is not inherently good, and its benefit depends on whether cost exposes a real change in signal reliability or error prevalence. When reusing the idea, retain the common budget and compare against both a static global threshold and a stronger global learner; otherwise an apparent gain may be confounded with additional capacity or looser spending.
应把这篇论文视为对“不确定性分数在进入预算化决策循环后究竟意味着什么”的提醒。最重要的实践教训来自负向对照：按成本分层本身并不天然有效，它是否有益取决于成本能否揭示信号可靠性或错误率的真实变化。复用该思路时，应保持相同预算，并同时与静态全局阈值和更强的全局学习器比较；否则表面上的提升可能混入了额外模型容量或更宽松支出的影响。
